  SUBJECT: ECE 1071 / ECE-1071 - BASIC ELECTRONICS  
  BASIC ELECTRONICS [ECE 1071]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1A)          A silicon diode has reverse saturation current of 50 nA at 27°C. Determine the voltage  
  required to get a forward current of 100 mA at 47°C. Also determine the static and           (4)  
  dynamic resistances of the diode at 47°C.  
  
  1B)          A certain MOSFET has µnCox = 0.5 mA/V2 and VTh = 0.5 V. If the length of the  
  channel is 180 nm, determine the width of the channel required to get the saturated drain (3)  
  $$current of 2 mA when VGS = 1.5 V.$$  
  
  1C)          Draw the structure of n-channel MOSFET and explain its operation.  
  (3)  
  
  2A)          Consider a sinusoidal voltage of 200 sin (100πt) volts applied to a full wave rectifier  
  with turns ratio 10:1. If the load resistance is 1kΩ, diodes are ideal, calculate.  
  i) Average load current.  
  ii) RMS load current                                                                         (4)  
  iii) Efficiency & Ripple factor  
  iv) Frequency of the output signal  
  
  
  2B)          Draw the circuit of Zener regulator and explain the principle of load and line regulation  
  with respective equations.                                                                   (3)  
  
  2C)          In a Zener regulator, RS = 120Ω, RL =250Ω and VZ = 5V. Find the minimum and  
  maximum current flowing through Zener diode when input varies from 9V to 15V.                (3)  
  
  3A)          A (7, 4) bit Hamming code received is 1110111. Considering even parity, check for  
  errors in the received code and if there is an error, write the corrected code. Also         (4)  
  represent the transmitted data from the corrected code word.  
  
  3B)          Draw the circuit diagram of an OPAMP non-inverting amplifier and derive the  
  expression for an output voltage. Given                       and the dc supply voltage is  
  ±12V. Calculate and plot the output voltage with respect to the input, if an input applied (3)  
  is 3sin (6284t) Volt.  
  
  3C)          Design an adder circuit using two OPAMP's to obtain:                                         (3)
